# Paola Mejia-Domenzain

> Co-Founder and CTO of Scholé AI and a PhD computer scientist from EPFL's Machine
> Learning for Education Laboratory. Builds and studies learning systems that model
> what students actually do — self-regulated learning, multimodal learning analytics,
> interpretable student models, and LLMs as tutors, feedback-givers and example generators.

Canonical: https://paola-md.github.io/ · ORCID 0000-0003-1242-3134 · 23 publications · updated 2026-09-14

Also indexed as Paola Mejia, Paola Mejía-Domenzain, Paola Mejia Domenzain and
P. Mejia-Domenzain — and, through a Unicode normalisation error in some databases,
with a U+2010 hyphen. All refer to the same person.

## Findings

Each line is a result stated in that paper's own abstract.

- Students judged identical feedback as less credible, and lower quality, when they were told it came from AI. — [Who Gives Feedback Matters: Student Biases Towards Human and AI-Generated Formative Feedback](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/who-gives-feedback-matters-student-biases-towards-human-and-ai-generated.html), Journal of Computer Assisted Learning 2025
- Students who could not tell who wrote the feedback rated the AI's higher; those who could tell preferred the human's. — [AI or Human? Evaluating Student Feedback Perceptions in Higher Education](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/ai-or-human-evaluating-student-feedback-perceptions-in-higher-education.html), European Conference on Technology Enhanced Learning (ECTEL 2024) 2024
- Data-storytelling annotations helped people find data points and grasp the main message, but did not help them complete higher-order analytical tasks. (128 participants, four visualisations.) — ["Piecing Data Connections Together Like a Puzzle": Effects of Increasing Task Complexity on the Effectiveness of Data Storytelling Enhanced Visualisations](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/piecing-data-connections-together-like-a-puzzle-effects-of-increasing-ta.html), CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI '25) 2025
- Gender and educational background correlated significantly with how much students trusted AI-powered educational technology. — [The critical role of trust in adopting AI-powered educational technology for learning: An instrument for measuring student perceptions](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/the-critical-role-of-trust-in-adopting-ai-powered-educational-technology.html), Computers and Education: Artificial Intelligence 2025
- Experienced teachers moved directly from lecturing into student interaction and then into real-time instructional adjustment; less experienced teachers did not. — [Behavioural transitions in team teaching](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/behavioural-transitions-in-team-teaching.html), ASCILITE 2025
- Loudness varied more in the speech of high-experience teachers, in undergraduate classes, and during collaborative tasks. — [AI-Driven Analytics of Team-Teaching Talk: Acoustic Patterns Across Experience, Cohorts and the Learning Design](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/ai-driven-analytics-of-team-teaching-talk-acoustic-patterns-across-exper.html), Lecture Notes in Computer Science 2026
- Seeing their own movement and interaction data helped co-teachers become more aware of how they actually teach together. — [TeamTeachingViz: Benefits, Challenges, and Ethical Considerations of Using a Multimodal Analytics Dashboard to Support Team Teaching Reflection](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/teamteachingviz-benefits-challenges-and-ethical-considerations-of-using-.html), Learning Analytics and Knowledge (LAK '25) 2025
- What teachers want from a learning-analytics dashboard differs considerably between blended and online contexts — preferences, requirements and concerns all shift. — [Making machine learning findings accessible to teachers in blended classrooms](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/making-machine-learning-findings-accessible-to-teachers-in-blended-class.html), International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education 2026
- Retrieving a worked example matched to the learner's own draft improved both writing performance and experience, drawing on a database of over 180,000 recipes. — [Enhancing Procedural Writing Through Personalized Example Retrieval: A Case Study on Cooking Recipes](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/enhancing-procedural-writing-through-personalized-example-retrieval-a-ca.html), International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education 2024
- Four learner profiles emerged, and combining inquiry strategies supported conceptual learning better than using any one alone. — [Teaching and Measuring Multidimensional Inquiry Skills using Interactive Simulations](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/teaching-and-measuring-multidimensional-inquiry-skills-using-interactive.html), Lecture Notes in Computer Science (AIED 2024) 2024
- What students say about their own self-regulated learning and what their trace data shows agree only weakly. — [Navigating Self-regulated Learning Dimensions: Exploring Interactions Across Modalities](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/navigating-self-regulated-learning-dimensions-exploring-interactions-acr.html), Lecture Notes in Computer Science 2024
- Showing teachers machine-learned learner profiles prompted concrete interventions and course changes, not just interest. — [Visualizing Self-Regulated Learner Profiles in Dashboards: Design Insights from Teachers](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/visualizing-self-regulated-learner-profiles-in-dashboards-design-insight.html), Communications in Computer and Information Science 2023
- Adaptive writing support measurably increased revision; learners improved over time, and women revised more efficiently. — [Understanding Revision Behavior in Adaptive Writing Support Systems for Education](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/understanding-revision-behavior-in-adaptive-writing-support-systems-for-.html), Zenodo 2023
- Multi-dimensional profiles held up across three different flipped-classroom courses, and the profiles differed significantly in academic performance. — [Identifying and Comparing Multi-dimensional Student Profiles Across Flipped Classrooms](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/identifying-and-comparing-multi-dimensional-student-profiles-across-flip.html), Lecture Notes in Computer Science 2022
- Across 183 chef apprentices and more than 121,000 learning-journal entries, the method tracked how learning patterns changed over time and produced interpretable profiles. — [Evolutionary Clustering of Apprentices' Self-Regulated Learning Behavior in Learning Journals](https://paola-md.github.io/papers/evolutionary-clustering-of-apprentices-self-regulated-learning-behavior-.html), IEEE Transactions on Learning Technologies 2022

## Named systems
- **Interpret3C** — interpretable student clustering that selects features per student rather than using one shared feature set
- **RELEX** — retrieval of a personalised worked example drawn from the learner's own draft
- **GELEX** — generative-AI extension of RELEX that writes an example when no suitable human one exists
- **TeamTeachingViz** — multimodal dashboard turning sensed speech, movement and collaboration into team-teaching reflection
- **BloomTutor** — retrieval-augmented tutor generating questions at a chosen Bloom's Taxonomy level
- **MCQStudentBert** — transformer forecasting which answer option a student will choose, not just whether they are right
